name: typewright-website-audit
description: Free website audit for small and local businesses by Typewright Studio, a small web studio in Wilson, NC run by Michael McClanahan. 20 scored checks on speed (Google PageSpeed), mobile, Google findability, trust and contact, and accessibility basics, each with a cited source. The URL you submit is sent to typewrightstudio.com and to Google PageSpeed Insights. Nothing is stored. Privacy: https://typewrightstudio.com/privacy/ Terms: https://typewrightstudio.com/terms/
